Good to know

Before you fly

Visa
UAE = visa-free
Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain need one.
Money
Rand · R100 ≈ $5
Bring USD, swap at the airport.
Internet
Vodacom tourist SIM
At arrivals. 20+20GB ≈ R599.
Plug
Type-M, 3 round pins
Pack a universal adapter.
Time
2 hrs behind UAE
Almost no jet lag.
Weather
Winter · 10–18°C
Layers + light rain jacket. Whale season.
Getting around
Uber, no car
Everywhere in town. A private driver for the Peninsula day.
Airport
~30 min to Camps Bay
Uber, or ask The Marly to send a transfer.
Getting around without a car

Uber is cheap and everywhere in the City Bowl, Camps Bay and the Waterfront, that covers most days. The Waterfront stretch is walkable end to end.

The Peninsula day needs a driver

Chapman's Peak → Boulders → Cape Point is one long loop with almost no Ubers past Simon's Town, you do not want to be stranded between stops with Alyaz. Book a private driver for the whole day (The Marly will quote you) or take a guided Peninsula tour.

The two long trips

Safari (2–3 hrs) and Hermanus (1.5–2 hrs) both need arranging up front: book the lodge's own transfer for the safari, and a tour or private driver for the whales.

Book early

GOLD Restaurant, the helicopter, Bukhara and Nobu fill up. Reserve as soon as dates are set.

Keep the mountain flexible

Table Mountain and Cape Point depend on wind. Take the first clear, calm morning you get.

Save for next time

Mossel Bay zipline, Cool Runnings toboggan and the Bloukrans bungee are 5–6 hrs east on the Garden Route. Not this trip.

Ten days, three beds, and a little girl who'll talk about penguins and lions forever.

Have the best trip, Hoor & Alyaz.

Prices are guides in ZAR (≈ USD) and shift with the season, always confirm when booking.
